description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) A WORTHY DEATH (Gladius Task Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Marine player gets the seven WP-M3a detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. Every Assault Intercessor is on 1 wound (setup privilege) so the Boyz destroy models. A real click (Ork player) on the Boyz in the fight list, All to target + Confirm in the attack dialog: enemy_targets_unit_fight opens for the Space Marine player; a REAL click on the Assault Intercessors' Use button spends 1 CP; each Assault Intercessor the Boyz destroy (the unit has not been selected to fight) rolls a D6 — on a 4+ it is not removed until the unit has fought or the end of the phase (the engine's Fight On Death).
